overview:
Maryland's 2nd District covers Baltimore County suburbs and leans Democratic by about ten points on partisanship. Johnny Olszewski, a first-term Democrat and former Baltimore County executive, seeks a second term after winning the seat in 2024. Republican Dave Wallace, a repeat challenger, has raised roughly twenty thousand dollars and reports about three thousand on hand, while Olszewski has raised over a million dollars and holds more than six hundred thousand. No outside groups have spent against the incumbent, and no expert raters have flagged the race as competitive.

No general-election polls are available, so the outlook rests on fundamentals and market pricing. Prediction markets put the Democratic chance near ninety-four percent. Given the incumbent's financial dominance, the district's lean, and a low-profile challenger, the seat is rated Safe Democratic, with the main uncertainty being the size of the winning margin.
